synthetic_rgb_probe.generation: Fixed diagnostic labels using the existing pinned standard scaffold and rich layout; no model call or application publication.

finding: The installed native path displays pure-red XML text/fill as blue while green remains green. This establishes a red/blue interpretation mismatch in the observed path; the download did not change source bytes or stored color values.

official_color_contract.finding: The current official model converts hash-prefixed XML RGB hexadecimal values to internal COLORREF BGR and applies the inverse on output. Ordinary font and brush colors use this converter. The existing rhwp mapping agrees with it.
official_color_contract.limit: Current official model behavior does not establish the installed Hancom2018 import implementation.

diagnostic_limits: The synthetic probe has a large black explanatory area and overlapping or repeated lower rows. It is used only for the visible RED/GREEN color observation, not layout, pagination, text-order or roundtrip quality.

The direct probe retained an empty-brush faceColor literal none, whereas the user download uses the existing #FFFFFFFF compatibility sentinel after rhwp serialization. This is consistent with the known Hancom2018 no-fill issue; exact painted bounds were not proven.

An earlier temporary native buffer for a separate source copy accidentally received 13 search characters and was not saved. That buffer is excluded from save-roundtrip evidence; its source file hash remained unchanged.
No numerical screenshot pixel measurement was collected.
